The request board is a source of s in Future Redeemed. It can be found in the Command Center in Yesterdale. Completing the nine quests on the board is necessary for raising Panacea and Linka's affinity.

The Relics of God, also called the Artifacts of God, are a group of mysterious objects in the Xenosaga series that are described in the Y-Data to have connections to the Higher Dimension and the Zohar.
Renken is one of 's Deathblows in Xenogears. Once Citan gains access to his Sword at the end of Disc 1, it is replaced by Yako.
Recyclers are an occupation in the Xenosaga series. They are individuals who often collect space wreck in space and sell them off.

Red Noponstone is a currency in Xenoblade Chronicles 3, unlocked with wave 2 of the Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Expansion Pass. It can be obtained by completing s, and traded for a variety of rewards in the . The equivalent for completing Archsage's Gauntlet challenges is Blue Noponstone.
Realians are a species in the Xenosaga series. They are a race of inorganic synthetic life most commonly known to be modeled after humans.
Relief Rifle is a in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. It is the main weapon of the .
Ricardo Banderas (), nicknamed Rico, is a playable character in Xenogears. He is a prisoner of Kislev's D-Block and champion of the Battling Arena.
Rewarding Work is the third skill in 's Integrity skill branch. It increases the amount of EXP gained from completing quests.
Resilient Warrior is the fourth skill in 's Integrity skill branch. It increases both his physical defence and ether defence by a small amount.

is a track in Xenosaga Episode III. It is a faster remix of survive. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. It plays in the following cutscenes: * The party hears Virgil's gunshots in the Old Miltia Forest. (The track continues as the area music until the party reaches Virgil.) * The party confronts the Realians attacking Virgil in the Old Miltia Forest. * Mai Magus summons Leupold to attack the party. * The Elsa dodges heavy fire to reach Merkabah.

Rod Blondel is a boss in Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse. It is encountered as part of GS 14 near the Segment Address 14 door. It can use Venom Touch to deal heavy strike damage to one fighter and inflict L Poison, or Hedro Dust to strike all 3 fighters and inflict L Poison. When low on health, it can also do a Venom Touch Combo which is a stronger version of the Venom Touch that does a larger amount of damage. The player cannot move during this fight, but they can still escape. Defeating it grants the .

Revised Carnicos I is an enemy in Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse. It is able to down a target and deal heavy damage to it.

Rescue to Attack is a cursed offered in the Archsage's Gauntlet in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. It boosts damage output (additive with other attack-boosting Emblems) by a percentage multiplied number of revives that have occurred during the stage (up to 10 times).

Rescue Recharge is a cursed offered in the Archsage's Gauntlet in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. When an ally is revived, all Arts are partially recharged. This emblem is initially locked and must be purchased in the shop Prize X-change Blue for 2000 Blue Noponstone.

Robots are a recurring form of artificial intelligence in the Xenosaga series. They appear as NPCs on the Elsa in every mainline entry. Bugs is a specialized robot created by Erich Weber who assists Jan Sauer and the team in hunting down Voyager in Xenosaga: Pied Piper.

In the fourth step of the Fame and Family, Falala will ask for Serenade, a medicine that will help her to sing better. The party, instead of making Serenade, will accidentally make a marvelous medicine called Serenade?. After Falala tries this medicine to find it does nothing, she asks the party to try again on making the Serenade with other ingredients. After the party succefully makes the correct Serenade, they give it to Falala and she becomes a talented singer.

Runners are a type of enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. Runners are common to multiple enemy species, namely: Ignas, Tirkin, Rapchors, Skwarors, Sovereigns, and Tantalese enemies. It is unclear what the purpose of the distinction is.
